response.sql:
WITH project_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.arcref,
    p.fundflux,
    AVG(ss.boxx / ss.boxz) AS project_ratio
  FROM scanspatial ss
  INNER JOIN projects p ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  WHERE ss.boxx IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz != 0
  GROUP BY ss.arcref, p.fundflux
),
fundflux_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    AVG(project_ratio) AS fundflux_avg_ratio
  FROM project_ratios
  GROUP BY fundflux
)
SELECT 
  pr.arcref,
  pr.fundflux,
  pr.project_ratio,
  pr.project_ratio - fa.fundflux_avg_ratio AS excess
FROM project_ratios pr
JOIN fundflux_avg fa ON pr.fundflux = fa.fundflux
ORDER BY pr.project_ratio - fa.fundflux_avg_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Rows where boxz = 0 are filtered out to avoid division by zero; rows with NULL boxx or NULL boxz are excluded from ratio calculation, per 'ignoring missing ones'.
Projects with NULL fundflux are grouped separately and compared to the average within that NULL group.
